## Context
This replacement tree consolidates 1,499 retired per-file source tickets into 6 workstream stories and 119 remediation leaves. At origin/main@e539e4a65d3e7451ca3dbc4b754ba4a2370cc3cc, the audited inventory has 1,449 distinct present execution paths: 1,432 linked directly to a historical source and 17 source-free paths (15 additions and 2 copied follow-up targets). Of the historical sources, 65 have no current path: 61 old-file deletions, 3 paths deleted after remediation, and 1 deleted partial successor. The two copied targets keep their historical source links under the original leaves. A grouped commit may list a sibling path in file_impact; Scope ownership and the present-path inventory count each path once. This epic makes no repository edits.

## Plan
- Complete every remaining leaf against its owned present Scope: recorded structural and focused checks, an independent per-block semantic/bloat review receipt, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with 0 unresolved comments, merged commit, and standalone completion verification. Historical leaves may document a deliberately delegated CI gate rather than claim an uncited local full run.
- Close each workstream only after all its children close and its log records separate historical-source and current-execution inventories, dispositions for moved/deleted/copied paths, and review/gate evidence.
- Combine the 6 story migration TSVs by immutable source ID and historical path. Preserve all 1,499 retired source rows, including those with no current path. Schema: source_id, source_alias, historical_source_path, story_alias, historical_replacement_leaf, disposition, verified_current_path_or_blank, current_action_leaf_or_blank, evidence.
- Combine the 6 story execution TSVs by present path at final origin/main. Count each of the 1,449 present paths once with one Scope owner; record source-free additions and copied targets. Schema: current_path, story_alias, execution_leaf_alias, source_count, retired_source_alias_or_blank, copy_source_alias_or_blank, scope_evidence, pinned_main.
- Store both combined TSVs, their SHA-256 values, the final main SHA, and all 6 story-log IDs in a linked epic session_log. The working drafts at e539e4a have broader crosswalk columns; transform and verify them against the final merged main before closing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 6 workstream stories and all 119 remediation leaves are closed.
- [ ] The migration inventory has exactly 1,499 distinct retired source IDs and historical paths, each with 1 net-active replacement leaf, a disposition, and evidence; the 65 sources with no current path remain counted.
- [ ] The execution inventory has exactly 1,449 distinct present paths at the final main SHA, each with 1 Scope owner; 1,432 have source_count=1 and 17 have source_count=0, distinguishing 15 additions from 2 copied follow-up targets.
- [ ] Moved and copied targets retain source identity; grouped-commit file_impact overlap does not inflate either inventory.
- [ ] Edited prose has independent per-block before/final review evidence for semantic preservation and bloat removal. Deleted historical files have explicit dispositions rather than invented current review rows.
- [ ] Each leaf trail records its applicable verification outcome (local pass or explicit CI delegation), Gerrit Change-Id, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments, MERGED status, and exact merged SHA reachable from final main.
- [ ] The epic log records both final inventories and all 6 story-log IDs. The epic completion comment cites the log, counts, SHA-256 values, and final main SHA.

## Completion boundary
Close only after all descendants close and the final inventory checks pass at the cited final main SHA.
